subject.title: fix(cli): report a cold-start session as "agent starting", not "needs reconnect"

question: Should the cold-start stderr token change from “agent needs reconnect” to “agent starting” despite possible downstream log parsers matching the old phrase?
rationale: The new wording matches the documented lifecycle and removes a false failure signal, but repository policy treats output naming as product surface and the token is externally observable.

options.title: Adopt “agent starting”
options.body: Accept the limited compatibility change because it accurately represents the normal startup path and avoids misleading failure detection.

options.title: Preserve the old phrase
options.body: Keep the current token until maintainers define a structured or versioned status surface for automation consumers.

recommendation.title: Adopt “agent starting”
recommendation.body: Accept the limited compatibility change because it accurately represents the normal startup path and avoids misleading failure detection.
